properties.description: Replaces the whole-file content_hash/prev_content_hash chain (dec:export-hash-chain's mechanism, not its purpose) with per-item chains. Tamper evidence and ancestry (compare_designs) are computed over items. A squash-merge lands each changed item exactly one hop, and unchanged items keep main's hash, so an export taken mid-merge cannot mis-chain. Designed 2026-09-23 (dec:the-designs-lineage-is-kept-per-item).
properties.name: Each node and edge carries its own content hash and the hash of the version it replaced, so the design's history stays independent of git
